contract_checks.synthetic_data_only: PASS: seeded 16 FIT + 4 query rows, 312 float32 features, all four FIT labels, no project dataset access in probe source.
contract_checks.CPU_and_dtype: PASS_BY_CODE: explicit device='cpu'; actual estimator.device_ and all model parameter/buffer device placements are checked for CPU; floating parameters must be FP32; configured threads do not exceed 3.
contract_checks.download_prevention: PASS_BY_CODE: explicit verified local checkpoint, allow_auto_download=False, manager sets HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1, and the pinned upstream loader loads an existing model_path directly.
contract_checks.no_training_or_F1: PASS_BY_CODE: no optimizer/backward/parameter-update calls and no F1/accuracy/real-data evaluation; official v2.2.0 classifier fit binds the synthetic in-context set and loads pretrained parameters, with upstream docs explicitly stating the model itself is not trained on fit data.
contract_checks.runtime_checks: PASS: saves first and repeated 4x4 probability matrices; checks finite values, row sums, classes_ and inverse mapping, exact repeated-prediction tolerance, and no gradients.
contract_checks.model_structure: PASS: retains full registered Linear list and separately inspects named icl_predictor.decoder Linear layers; compares output-head dimensions and full parameter count with historical reference.
contract_checks.root_bound_output: PASS: output resolves under project root; manager passes --checkpoint and --output matching the script CLI; staged JSON, temp, and caches are root-local under manager environment.
contract_checks.attempt_and_timeout: PASS_BY_WRAPPER: only first smoke is currently allowed, each child smoke is capped at 180s, and the wrapper checks available system RAM >=3 GiB before starting.
contract_checks.install_and_ram_gates: CONDITIONAL: manager must first verify successful install receipt, pip check exit 0, and pinned versions. Manager reported last available RAM about 2.12 GiB; reviewer did not sample it. Current launch must be skipped if wrapper reports <3 GiB.

authoritative_api_sources.supports: Pinned constructor arguments, local model_path with allow_auto_download disabled, .eval() model load, and fit docstring/implementation stating model weights are not trained.
ICLearning decoder is Linear -> GELU -> Linear; classifier batch forward uses torch.no_grad().

reviewed_runtime_evidence.verification_method: read-only inspection of installed source files and upstream v2.2.0 primary source; no import or model load
verified_claims: fit resolves device_ and moves model to device_

limitations: This is a code/API precheck only; model load, synthetic inference, probability checks, and runtime success are not established until a gated smoke runs.
Manager-reported current RAM was below the configured 3 GiB threshold; do not launch/model-load unless the wrapper's launch-time measurement reaches the threshold.
The install disk guard is local wheel/temp artifact accounting rather than exact network byte accounting, as documented in install_precheck.json.
